connections.untrained: Lo msebenzi usebenzise izinsiza ze-Google, idatha yazo okungafanele neze iqeqeshe i-AI, futhi ingqondo {brain} ingase iziqeqeshe ngalokho ekufundayo. Khetha ingqondo engakwenzi neze lokho, noma wengeze eyodwa, njengalezi: {brains}.
connections.keyHint: Kuphela uma insiza ikunike ukhiye. Uma kungenjalo uzocelwa ukuthi ungene.
connections.failed: Akukwazekanga ukuxhuma. Hlola ikheli: ezinye izinsiza azikakwamukeli ukuxhuma okuvela esipheqululini.
connections.needsKey: Le nsiza idinga ukuthi ungene, noma ukhiye.
connections.failedKnown: Akukwazekanga ukuxhuma ensizeni {service}. Zama futhi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
gateway.title: Isango
gateway.text: Ezinye izinsiza azikakwamukeli ukuxhuma okuvela esipheqululini. Umsizi {name} angazifinyelela ngesango, eliqhutshwa yinhlangano yakho noma nguwe: faka ikheli lalo lapha.
connections.lede: Ikhasi lensiza ngayinye lisho lokho umsizi {name} angakwenza lapho.
connections.usual: Uma ungakhethi lutho lapha, umsizi {name} ulandela Izimvume, njengakuyo yonke insiza.
connections.guarded: Izimvume zinomthetho oqinile wensiza {service}, oza kuqala.
connections.trains: Lokho insiza {service} ekulethayo kuya kuphela ezingqondweni ezingaziqeqeshi neze ngakho.
connections.noBrain: Lokho insiza {service} ekulethayo akufanele neze kuqeqeshe i-AI, futhi zonke izingqondo onazo zingase ziziqeqeshe ngalokho ezikufundayo. Ukuze uyisebenzise, engeza engakwenzi neze lokho, njengalezi: {brains}.
connections.disconnectAsk: Nqamula insiza {service}? Ukhiye wayo uyasuswa kumadivayisi akho. Akukho okushintshayo ensizeni uqobo.
connections.laterText: Ngesango, eliqhutshwa yinhlangano yakho noma nguwe
connections.otherText: Okwensiza umsizi {name} angayibali. Ikheli layo livela ensizeni, noma enhlanganweni yakho.
connections.signInThere: Uma insiza {service} icela, ungena lapho, bese ubuyela lapha. Umsizi {name} akayiboni neze iphasiwedi yakho.
connections.sealed: Ukhiye wayo uhlala kumadivayisi akho, uvikelwe, futhi awuyi neze esipeleni, kokukhishwayo noma kokwabelwana ngakho.
connections.another: Insiza {service} isivele ixhunyiwe: lokhu kwengeza enye i-akhawunti.
